title: Why Vested RSUs Leave a Tax Bill in April: 22% Withheld vs. Your Marginal Rate #Shorts
description:
Payroll withholds a flat 22% on vested RSUs; stacked on a salary the same dollars are taxed at 24–37%. The KDesk RSU Tax Planner shows the gap for every vest and year, and the equal quarterly installments that would reach the federal safe harbor.
Free calculator: https://kdeskaccounting.com/rsu-tax-calculator/
Workbook: https://kdeskaccounting.com/templates/rsu-planner/
